name: The Dolder Grand
insider_take: A fairy-tale castle perched above Zurich where old-world grandeur meets cutting-edge luxury, offering breathtaking Alpine views and world-class art.
whats_special: This iconic 1899 castle-hotel features an impressive contemporary art collection including works by Dalí and Warhol. The award-winning spa spans 4,000 square meters with an outdoor pool offering panoramic city and lake views. Chef Heiko Nieder's two-Michelin-starred Restaurant brings innovative cuisine to this historic setting.
pro_tip: Take the historic funicular railway from Römerhof station directly to the hotel - it's been operating since 1895 and adds a magical arrival experience while avoiding Zurich's busy streets.
dont_miss: The hotel's sculpture park featuring rotating exhibitions, sunset cocktails on the terrace overlooking Lake Zurich and the Alps, and the legendary Sunday brunch that locals consider Zurich's finest. The nearby Zurich Zoo, just a 10-minute walk away, houses the famous Masoala Rainforest Hall.
pros: Iconic castle-like architecture with stunning panoramic views of Zurich and the Alps
World-class spa facility with extensive wellness treatments and facilities
Multiple award-winning dining options including Michelin-starred restaurants
Exceptional art collection and museum-quality interior design throughout the property
cons: Located outside central Zurich requiring transportation to downtown attractions
